passages.text: Of the 47 PDGLs identified, 25 are in the Tibet Autonomous Region of China, 21 in Nepal, and one in India.

Neither Thyanbo nor any Thame-valley lake appears anywhere in this inventory. We verified this directly against the report text and against all 47 lake-ID centroids; the nearest listed lake is Lumding, 5.76 km away. This does not mean the lake was unknown to science - it means it fell outside the screening criteria.
